text: What did the stranger want at the stable?
why: A plain question the story has raised: the stranger appeared at the stable at night and his purpose is not yet explained. The wording does not point to any answer.

text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — find the way
why: The stranger has just asked Edith where he is and said he nearly slept on the moor, so finding his way is a possibility the story gives the reader reason to consider.
